_about: The sha256 of every 2001 vector depth zip (FIDQ downloadBathymetricMap.do) a placing may read (T1267). Committed; the zips themselves are git-ignored under data/source/bathymetry_vectors/ (`python -m pipeline.bathymetry.fetch_vectors`). Read by pipeline.bathymetry.vectors.zip_path, which raises on a missing folder, a missing zip or a different hash. 510 zips for 512 sheets: 00153501 and 00153701 each hold a second line coverage that repeats the first (`duplicate_coverage`). Regenerate only for a deliberate new fetch: `python -m pipeline.bathymetry.fetch_vectors --write-hashes`.
